passages.text: 1. Introduction. The authority is procuring a managed cloud platform for its internal systems.
The evaluation committee will score proposals against the criteria in section 9.
The supplier shall host all production data in data centres located within the European Union.
The supplier shall encrypt all customer data at rest using AES-256 or an equivalent algorithm.
All data in transit must be protected with TLS 1.2 or later.
The platform shall provide single sign-on using SAML 2.0 or OpenID Connect.
Definitions. 'Service' means the managed platform described in this document.
The supplier must provide role based access control for every administrative function.
Every administrative action shall be written to an immutable audit log that is retained for 24 months.
The supplier should provide a documented data export in an open format on request.
The authority reserves the right to cancel the procurement at any time without liability.
Service availability shall be at least 99.9 percent measured per calendar month.
The supplier shall provide telephone support from 08:00 to 18:00 on every working day.
Critical incidents must be acknowledged within 30 minutes.
The supplier shall deliver a monthly service report covering availability and incidents.
Proposals must be submitted electronically before the closing date stated on the cover page.
The supplier may offer an additional sandbox environment at no extra charge.
The supplier shall encrypt all customer data at rest using AES-256.
Service availability shall be at least 99.5 percent measured per calendar month.
Annex A lists the sites that will use the platform during the first year.
The supplier shall support restoration of any backup within four hours.
The supplier shall perform a penetration test at least once a year and share a summary with the authority.
